006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.CollectionUtil;
010
011import java.util.LinkedList;
012import java.util.List;
013import java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock;
014
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016
017/**
018 * Represents a container of rules constraining the effective model of a
019 * Metaschema assembly data instance.
020 */
021public class AssemblyConstraintSet
022    extends ValueConstraintSet
023    implements IModelConstrained {
024
025  @NonNull
026  private final List<IIndexConstraint> indexConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
027  @NonNull
028  private final List<IUniqueConstraint> uniqueConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
029  @NonNull
030  private final List<ICardinalityConstraint> cardinalityConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
031
032  /**
033   * Construct a new constraint set.
034   *
035   * @param source
036   *          information about the resource the constraints were loaded from
037   */
038  public AssemblyConstraintSet(@NonNull ISource source) {
039    super(source);
040  }
041
042  @Override
043  public List<IIndexConstraint> getIndexConstraints() {
044    Lock readLock = getLock().readLock();
045    readLock.lock();
046    try {
047      return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(indexConstraints);
048    } finally {
049      readLock.unlock();
050    }
051  }
052
053  @Override
054  public List<IUniqueConstraint> getUniqueConstraints() {
055    Lock readLock = getLock().readLock();
056    readLock.lock();
057    try {
058      return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(uniqueConstraints);
059    } finally {
060      readLock.unlock();
061    }
062  }
063
064  @Override
065  public List<ICardinalityConstraint> getHasCardinalityConstraints() {
066    Lock readLock = getLock().readLock();
067    readLock.lock();
068    try {
069      return CollectionUtil.unmodifiableList(cardinalityConstraints);
070    } finally {
071      readLock.unlock();
072    }
073  }
074
075  @Override
076  public final void addConstraint(@NonNull IIndexConstraint constraint) {
077    Lock writeLock = getLock().writeLock();
078    writeLock.lock();
079    try {
080      getConstraintsInternal().add(constraint);
081      indexConstraints.add(constraint);
082    } finally {
083      writeLock.unlock();
084    }
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  public final void addConstraint(@NonNull IUniqueConstraint constraint) {
089    Lock writeLock = getLock().writeLock();
090    writeLock.lock();
091    try {
092      getConstraintsInternal().add(constraint);
093      uniqueConstraints.add(constraint);
094    } finally {
095      writeLock.unlock();
096    }
097  }
098
099  @Override
100  public final void addConstraint(@NonNull ICardinalityConstraint constraint) {
101    Lock writeLock = getLock().writeLock();
102    writeLock.lock();
103    try {
104      getConstraintsInternal().add(constraint);
105      cardinalityConstraints.add(constraint);
106    } finally {
107      writeLock.unlock();
108    }
109  }
110}
